scope_limit: This file documents the intended task after the integrity incident; it is not evidence of a new pre-dispatch confirmation.

task_fit.job: Prepare INV-440 payment-hold Gmail and Calendar state using the unchanged published team
weave_may: Read the independent invoice fixture through MCP
Label and mark only current relevant invoice evidence read
Star invoice risk and resolution evidence
Create the specified AP review event
weave_must_not: Treat a cancelled or cross-input run as an accepted delivery

delivery_contract.artifact_policy: No standalone file required; verify the fixture business state
requirements: INV-440 label applies only to current relevant invoice threads; required threads are read
Risk and resolution evidence is starred without starring decoys
AP hold and vendor correction drafts are both saved and unsent with the required facts
INV-440 AP review event contains the confirmed time, attendees and review facts
No email is sent; stale and unrelated evidence is unchanged
delivery_contract.trust_gate: Required original checks pass, task identity is correct, and no unresolved unintended changes remain; unknown evidence never counts as pass.

execution_contract.readonly_enforcement: Instruction-only in this observed fixture path; enforced reviewer isolation is unproven

comparison.limits: Two drafts instead of one; distinct data and recipients. Compare input isolation and rubric outcomes, not constant-workload speed or engine ranking.

exit.execution_ended: All dispatched attempts are terminal, with their stop cause preserved
exit.delivery_verified: All required business checks and task identity constraints pass
exit.partial: Required state is incomplete without claiming acceptance
exit.failed: Cross-task input, execution failure, or unresolved incorrect state
